factors.name: A proper test of golf
factors.hint: wants holes that test their game without beating them up

factors.name: Beautiful surroundings
factors.hint: wants prettier holes to look at

factors.name: A brisk pace of play
factors.hint: is tired of waiting behind slow groups

factors.name: Immaculate turf
factors.hint: wants the course in better condition

factors.name: Food, drink and comfort
factors.hint: wants somewhere to eat, drink and sit down out on the course

factors.name: An easy walk
factors.hint: finds the course a tiring walk; paths, carts and benches would help

factors.name: Prestige
factors.hint: wants to belong to a club people have heard of

factors.name: Variety
factors.hint: wants more holes, and more kinds of hole

factors.name: Peace and safety
factors.hint: would like a round where nothing lands on them

factors.name: Good company
factors.hint: wants a memorable day out with their playing partners

factors.name: Practice facilities
factors.hint: wants a driving range and a putting green

factors.name: Thrills
factors.hint: wants danger, drama and a story to tell afterwards
